variants: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests.
